{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u037/system/state/workspace/programs/task-056e678c.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            maxr = max(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            maxc = max(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = [[grid[y][x] if (y, x) in set(cells) else 0
                      for x in range(minc, maxc + 1)]
                     for y in range(minr, maxr + 1)]
            objects.append((minc, minr, shape))
    objects.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    out_h = max(len(shape) for _, _, shape in objects)
    out_w = sum(len(shape[0]) for _, _, shape in objects)
    out = [[0] * out_w for _ in range(out_h)]
    offset = 0
    for _, _, shape in objects:
        for y, row in enumerate(shape):
            out[y][offset:offset + len(row)] = row
        offset += len(shape[0])
    return out
"
